review_notes: The target file has only two theorems and a wrapper `solution`. It introduces no definition, structure or class. The concept it talks about, `GaloisRep.ratLocalizedAt`, is defined in Definitions/Def_GaloisRep_Flat.lean, outside the target. That definition is the subring {q : ℚ | q.den.Coprime p}, and it is defined for any natural p, not only primes. For prime p it resembles the integer subring of Mathlib's `Rat.padicValuation p` (in Mathlib/NumberTheory/Padics/PadicNumbers.lean). Mathlib's `Rat.padicValuation_le_one_iff` is the analogue of `mem_ratLocalizedAt_iff`. I found no matching Mathlib subring for ℚ localized at a prime, and the definition is more general than the prime case. Duplicating a lemma is excluded by the rubric. I therefore found no avoidable competing concept in this file. I did not check every use of `ratLocalizedAt` in the project.
